title: Why Leaves Change Color: Red and Purple

scenes.title: WHERE RED COMES FROM
scenes.caption: Some leaves make red pigments in autumn.
scenes.narration: Some trees produce red pigments as autumn arrives.

scenes.title: MEET ANTHOCYANINS
scenes.caption: Anthocyanins create red, purple, and crimson.
scenes.narration: Anthocyanins create vivid red and purple shades.

scenes.title: A BRIGHT AUTUMN RED
scenes.caption: Cool nights and sunny days can help.
scenes.narration: Sunny days and cool nights can strengthen red colors.

scenes.title: RED IS NOT IN EVERY LEAF
scenes.caption: Some trees make more anthocyanin than others.
scenes.narration: Maples often turn red; other trees turn mostly yellow.

scenes.title: WHY MAKE RED PIGMENT?
scenes.caption: Scientists study several possible benefits.
scenes.narration: Anthocyanins may help protect leaves during nutrient recovery.

scenes.title: A COLORFUL MIX
scenes.caption: Red can combine with yellow and orange.
scenes.narration: Red pigments mix with yellow for fiery autumn colors.
